_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. The vendor is currently working on the fob system installing new memory equipment for each door. As they work through the installation, each door will have a period of time that it will be down. These outages will last approximately one hour per door. They will only be working on one door at a time, so if a door is not working, please try another one. If you have any questions, please contact the office. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
